command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== step: baseline auth.log tail =="
sudo -n tail -5 /var/log/auth.log

echo "== step: write drop-in =="
cat <<'EOF' | sudo -n tee /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging >/dev/null
Defaults logfile="/var/log/sudo-commands.log"
Defaults log_year, log_host
Defaults !syslog
EOF
sudo -n chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging

echo "== step: validate sudoers syntax =="
sudo -n visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging

echo "== step: pre-create log file with safe perms =="
sudo -n touch /var/log/sudo-commands.log
sudo -n chown root:root /var/log/sudo-commands.log
sudo -n chmod 0600 /var/log/sudo-commands.log

echo "== step: trigger a sudo command to test logging =="
sudo -n whoami
sudo -n id

echo "== verify: sudo-commands.log contents =="
sudo -n cat /var/log/sudo-commands.log

echo "== verify: no new sudo entries reached auth.log =="
sudo -n tail -5 /var/log/auth.log

echo "== verify: journal has no fresh sudo COMMAND entries =="
sudo -n journalctl -q --no-pager -n 20 | grep -i sudo || echo "no sudo entries in recent journal"
